task.name_zh: 四套件多任务轨迹偏移诊断
task.hypothesis: 检验量化是否改变平移分散度、旋转有向漂移，以及是否存在跨初态重复的可补偿窗口；允许无拐点。
task.changed_variable: 首轮固定多suite OFT检查点、输入、8动作执行与配对初态，仅改变权重量化档；不训练。

perturbation.scope: Separate independent, versioned short probe after natural-drift diagnosis; no full grid expansion and no DyQ implementation
perturbation.case_and_direction_selection: Freeze before confirmation; no success-based selection

analysis.time_pairing: Control-step pose comparison; same-observation action replay uses identical query input; no perturbation registered
required_initial_state_checks: unique physical states for five indices
training/calibration/evaluation role separation; no holdout labels
reference_modes: matched-reset BF16 versus quantized natural trajectories
same-observation BF16 versus quantized action replay; serial model loading
analysis.primary_estimand: Paired method-vs-BF16 effects, reported per task and suite before pooled effects
analysis.cohort_rule: Method-specific complete pairs across time plus all-planned outcomes, available-case curves and risk sets; never globally intersect all quantizers
analysis.confidence_intervals: Task-cluster/stratified-by-suite resampling if used; retain five initials and precision pairing as a block; do not bootstrap frames
analysis.turning_window_rule: Freeze threshold and persistent-change/event rules before three confirmation initials; allow no turning point and gradual drift
analysis.claim_scope: LIBERO task/initial-state robustness; not unseen-task or cross-benchmark generalization
analysis.display_timebase: Full natural rollout control steps and simulation seconds, plus event-aligned views; no five-query truncation

pending_admissions: native model checkpoint/source/action coordinates and original execution schedule
method-specific target modules/granularity/profile and actual numerical gate
observer on/off identity, matched RNG, finite, freeze and save/reload
actual five initial-state hashes, task-name ordering and role separation
independent calibration manifests and frozen scales
per-GPU UUID locks, ownership, actual peak memory, global quota/stop propagation
fresh authorized server identity, disk budget and round-bound authorization

operations.additional_workspace_gate: Also require the actual method build/calibration/profile plus archive spool estimate; minima alone are insufficient. ActQuant upstream documents about 50 GB scratch.
operations.archive: Public code/config/small results; private raw observations/actions/videos/checkpoints; incremental SHA/digest verified
operations.server_shutdown: After all owned workers stopped and GPU idle; attempt closure even if upload incomplete, preserving persistent originals
operations.heartbeat_scope: One consolidated 15-minute node status/actual GPU/process/disk snapshot, no episode log polling

scope_override_v5: Independent pre/post-quantization drift diagnosis; DyQ ideas/benchmark reference only. No DyQ code replication, dynamic routing or compensation.

condition_catalog.calibration_note: Record LWC/LET choices and optimizer/calibration cost separately; no policy LoRA training.

condition_catalog.bit_budget_note: W4 denotes the target average budget; record achieved tensor/module-weighted bits, GGUF format, full-model bytes, protected modules and runtime. Do not replace action-guided allocation with uniform INT4.

condition_catalog.adaptation_note: Public release inspected is GR00T-focused; pi05/OFT adapters unverified. Preserve ATM/OHB and target-module identity, not a generic DuQuant alias.

excluded_conditions.reason: Public Hessian-proxy/fake-quant workflow and no pi05/GR00T implementation do not establish the requested three-backbone action-sensitivity method; excluded from this study, not declared permanently impossible.
User explicitly requests ideas/benchmark reference only; do not reproduce its code, precision switching or compensation. Would confound independent drift/OPD diagnosis.

calibration.source: Independent calibration manifests; reuse SHA-verified existing data where suitable; never count as evaluation
calibration.per_method_recipe_and_label_requirements: Explicitly record any method-specific calibration labels, optimization and differences

hardware_plan.execution_model: Independent inference workers, one resident model per GPU; no DDP or pooled VRAM
hardware_plan.bf16_teacher: Serial load/replay or one separately admitted teacher GPU; no unverified two-model co-residency
hardware_plan.existing_infra_runner: Serial runner checks global GPU occupancy; concurrent dispatch requires a separate per-GPU ownership/admission implementation
hardware_plan.profile_generation: Once per model/method/recipe; immutable SHA shared read-only
hardware_plan.quota: One fresh controller primary observation; 15% stop all new dispatch, 10% save/stop all owned workers and close this paid server
